request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When does my residence permit expire, and what should I do before then?

response.text:
Your residence permit (student permit) expires on Mon 30 Nov 2026 [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].

**What to do before then**
- **Go to your extension appointment.** It is on Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 at the Ausländerbehörde, Musterplatz 1, Room 2.14 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp].
- **Bring the original documents the office lists.** These are your valid passport, your current enrolment certificate, proof of funds, proof of health insurance, a biometric photo, and your tenancy contract or landlord confirmation [doc:doc_d9hwr1mp3bsj].
- **Pay the fee by girocard on site.** Cash is not accepted. The fee is 100.00 € and is due on the appointment day, Wed 14 Oct 2026 [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].
- **Cancel if you can't attend.** The letter asks for at least three working days' notice. Ordnung's date for this is Mon 19 Oct 2026, with a send-by date of Tue 13 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78]. Those dates come after the appointment itself, so please check the deadline against the letter.
- **Apply before the permit expires.** If you apply in time, your permit usually counts as still valid until the office decides (§ 81 Abs. 4 AufenthG). Ask for a Fiktionsbescheinigung [item:itm_p0k64jp7r8bf].
- **Check your passport.** It expires on Wed 10 Feb 2027, and Ordnung says that date needs checking [item:itm_cw9j6w5ppdvs]. A permit generally can't be issued for longer than the passport is valid. Ask the office whether you need a new passport.

If you have questions about your residence status, it's worth getting advice.

Sehr geehrter Herr Rivera,

Ihre Aufenthaltserlaubnis zum Zweck des Studiums nach § 16b Abs. 1 des Aufenthaltsgesetzes
(AufenthG) ist bis zum 30.11.2026 gültig. Wenn Sie Ihren Aufenthalt über diesen Zeitpunkt hinaus
fortsetzen möchten, müssen Sie vor Ablauf der Gültigkeit die Verlängerung beantragen. Für die
Antragstellung haben wir für Sie folgenden Termin reserviert:

Ihr Termin
